instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a dry grassy field under a clear blue sky, the woman in the shearling-lined denim jacket (R1) on the left and the man in the denim jacket (R2) on the right walk forward hand-in-hand. They look at each other with joyful smiles, holding hands in the center. Bright natural sunlight casts soft shadows across the dry grass, highlighting their happy expressions in a warm, sunny color palette.
